component.name: Nodeplay
component.summary: Control your Bluesound and other BluOS players

description.p: A fast, native Linux app for BluOS music streamers — Bluesound NODE, POWERNODE, PULSE, NAD and others — on your home network. Unofficial; not affiliated with Lenbrook.

The app talks directly to your player over your home network, using the BluOS API that Lenbrook (the maker of Bluesound and BluOS) publishes for integrations — the same local interface the official apps use. No cloud service, no account, nothing extra installed on the player.

ul.li: Now playing, volume, queue, favourites and recently played
Browse and search TIDAL, TuneIn, Radio Paradise and your own music library
Share a music folder from this PC to the player in one click
Alarms, sleep timer and player settings
Bluetooth: play from your phone, or listen on Bluetooth headphones

description.p: Tested on a Bluesound NODE. Using another BluOS device? Tell us what works and what you need.

screenshot.caption: Home: favourites, most used and recently played

description.p: Available on Flathub. In the Flatpak version, sharing a folder from this PC is done in your file manager; the app shows how.

ul.li: Alarms: wake up to a favourite, an input or the current queue
Bluetooth page: play from your phone or connect headphones
Notices when the player is offline or has a firmware update
